## Rules

- Baseline selection and six-step proof are exactly §7. Pin package version, immutable ref and archive digest. `not-applicable/new-package` requires observed remote absence and still runs clean install. Update exact package constraints only; no path repository.

## Guidance

Reuse the existing populated-baseline and forward-retry pattern. Store fixture and before/after digests, migration list, Composer argv/lock diff and compatibility outputs. Use disposable databases and rerun the upgrade command to prove idempotence.
